info.name: FlyRaudah OTA Mobile API
info.description: Contract 1.0.2. Import the companion environment. Use local-only tokens and a separate staging host. All customer writes are skipped by default; booking writes require a second explicit flag. Importing this collection never sends requests. Current Postman supporting pm.execution.skipRequest is required. Search/quote IDs expire; retrieve fresh inventory before checkout. No provider/admin endpoints or secrets are included.

request.description:
Public feature switches, mode and support contacts. Hide disabled checkout and Stays actions.

Read-only; bounded retry with backoff.

Customer writes are disabled by default. Replace sample traveller/contact data and review the current price before any checkout.

exec: if (data.offers?.[0]) { pm.environment.set('offer_id', data.offers[0].id); pm.environment.set('passenger_id', data.offers[0].passengers?.[0]?.id || ''); pm.environment.set('expected_total_kobo', String(data.offers[0].pricing?.totalKobo || 0)); }

Repeat against the same saved booking after inspecting state; payment/supplier claims are protected against duplicate fulfillment.
